steps.name: Step 1 — Confirm default view is Flow, then switch to Yaml view
Step 2 — Edit the LLM node's transition target in the YAML editor: END → Code 1
Step 3 — Switch back to Flow view
Step 4 — Verify the canvas reflects the updated edge; structure re-wired, not re-created
Step 5 — Verify Save becomes enabled, confirming the disabled->enabled transition caused by the YAML edit (not a pre-existing always-on dirty state)
